skill.name: baoyu-article-illustrator
skill.description: Analyzes article structure, recommends visual placements, and generates consistent raster illustrations using type, style, and palette choices.
skill.summary: Plan and generate consistent article illustrations from structured visual prompts.
skill.author: JimLiu

security_audit.summary: All 106 static matches are false positives after review. They point to Markdown links, code formatting, documentation examples, expected preference paths, metadata, or an explicit statement that the image wrapper does not read OPENAI_API_KEY. The skill still relies on the selected image backend and local output paths, so users should review those integrations before use.

remediation.issue: Configuration files under project and home directories are trusted as user preferences.
remediation.suggestion: Restrict reads to the documented paths, treat configuration contents as untrusted instructions, and show the resolved path before applying settings.

remediation.issue: The workflow can route image generation through an installed wrapper or external CLI.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user confirmation for backend selection and verify the resolved executable before invoking it.

remediation.issue: Generated files and prompt records use paths derived from article and topic names.
remediation.suggestion: Normalize slugs, reject path separators, and keep all output paths beneath the selected article output directory.

content.value_statement: Article authors often know their message but lack a clear visual plan. This skill finds useful illustration points and prepares consistent raster image generation prompts.
actual_capabilities: Analyze article structure and identify sections where illustrations add value.
Recommend illustration types such as infographics, scenes, flowcharts, comparisons, frameworks, and timelines.
Apply style, palette, density, language, and output preferences from user choices or presets.
Create an outline and save full image prompts as reproducible prompt files.
Generate raster images through an available native tool or configured image backend.
Insert relative image links and report the completed image set.
limitations: It requires an available raster image-generation backend.
It does not guarantee accurate text rendering inside generated images.
It does not rewrite article content or replace editorial review.
Output quality depends on the selected backend, references, and source article.

use_cases.title: Plan a technical article
use_cases.description: Turn a technical article into a visual outline with diagrams for systems, metrics, workflows, and key relationships.

use_cases.title: Create a visual tutorial
use_cases.description: Add step-focused scenes or flowcharts to make a tutorial easier to scan and understand.

use_cases.title: Refresh editorial content
use_cases.description: Generate a consistent set of article illustrations with a selected style, palette, density, and output location.

prompt_templates.title: Simple article illustration
prompt_templates.prompt: Read this article, identify the three strongest illustration opportunities, and propose one clear raster image concept for each.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a visual system
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this article and recommend an illustration type, style, palette, density, and language. Explain each choice briefly.

prompt_templates.title: Build an illustration outline
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an outline for this article with image positions, purposes, visual content, filenames, and a consistent type, style, and palette.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a complete generation run
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze the article, ask for required settings, create structured prompt files for each illustration, generate the raster images in batches, and insert relative links.

output_examples.input: A tutorial explaining how a request moves through a web application.
output_examples.output: Recommended visual: a left-to-right flowchart showing the request, validation, service layer, database, and response. Suggested style: blueprint with a restrained technical palette.

output_examples.input: An article comparing local and hosted development environments.
output: Illustration 1: comparison graphic with matching columns for setup, privacy, speed, and collaboration.
Illustration 2: decision flowchart showing when each environment is suitable.

best_practices: Provide the complete article and state the intended audience.
Confirm the visual type, density, style, palette, and language before generation.
Review saved prompts, generated text, file paths, and Markdown links before publishing.
anti_patterns: Do not request images without supplying the article or its key sections.
Do not skip confirmation unless the current request explicitly authorizes direct generation.
Do not patch unreadable image text programmatically; revise the prompt and regenerate.

faq.question: What input does the skill need?
faq.answer: Provide an article file or pasted article content. State any preferred visual type, style, palette, density, language, or output location.

faq.question: Which image types are supported?
faq.answer: The workflow supports infographics, scenes, flowcharts, comparisons, frameworks, timelines, and mixed selections.

faq.question: Can I choose a visual style?
faq.answer: Yes. Choose a style and optional palette directly, or use a preset that selects all three visual dimensions.

faq.question: Does it generate the images?
faq.answer: Yes, when a compatible raster backend is available. The skill selects a native tool or a configured installed backend.

faq.question: Does it ask for confirmation?
faq.answer: Yes. Confirmation is required by default before outline generation and image generation. An explicit direct-generation request can skip it.

faq.question: Can it correct text in an image?
faq.answer: It does not paint over generated text. It creates a corrected prompt and regenerates the image when text needs improvement.
